disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in the practice of applied behavior analysis or fraud/deceit in admission to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant is guilty of fraud in the practice of applied behavior analysis or fraud or deceit in the licensee's admission to practice applied behavior analysis

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude in the past five years.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant has been convicted of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude as defined in subdivision 22-1-2(25) during the past five years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name without proper registration, or impersonating another practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant is or has been engaged in the practice of applied behavior analysis under a false or assumed name and has not registered that name pursuant to chapter 37-11, or is impersonating another practitioner of a like or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to intoxicating liquors, narcotics, or stimulants to the extent of incapacitation from professional duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant is addicted to the use of intoxicating liquors, narcotics, or stimulants to an extent as to incapacitate the licensee or applicant from the performance of the licensee's or applicant's professional duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental condition that jeopardizes or endangers a person seeking relief from the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The physical or mental condition of the licensee or applicant is determined, by a competent medical examiner, to jeopardize or endanger a person who seeks relief of the licensee or applicant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the code of ethics adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant for licensure has been found in violation of the code of ethics adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal by bribery or fraudulent representation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant has obtained or attempted to obtain a license, certificate, or renewal thereof by bribery or fraudulent representation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement in connection with any application required by the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant knowingly made a false statement in connection with any application required by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement on any form promulgated under the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or applicant knowingly made a false statement on any form promulgated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rules promulgated under it.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate, license, or permit cancelled, revoked, suspended, or rejected for renewal in any other state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee's or applicant's certificate, license, or permit has been cancelled, revoked, suspended, or rejected for renewal in any other state for any cause.

assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.quote: Assistant behavior analyst or paraprofessional who delivers applied behavior analysis services under the extended authority and direction of a behavior analyst provided that the services are supervised in accordance with the requirements of the Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Inc.

supervisee_technician_exemption.quote: Assistant behavior analyst or paraprofessional who delivers applied behavior analysis services under the extended authority and direction of a behavior analyst provided that the services are supervised in accordance with the requirements of the Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Inc. The assistant behavior analyst or paraprofessional may not represent himself or herself as a behavior analyst

family_member_caregiver_exemption.quote: Family member of a recipient of applied behavior analysis services implementing behavior analysis treatment plans with the recipient under the extended authority and direction of a behavior analyst. The family member may not represent himself or herself as a behavior analyst

temporary_license_available.quote: Provider who is not a resident of this state, and who has established an office in this state, who provides behavior analyst services in this state for a period which does not exceed an aggregate of more than twenty days during any one year if the provider is authorized under the laws of the state or country of residence to perform these activities and services.

temporary_license_max_days_per_year.quote: provides behavior analyst services in this state for a period which does not exceed an aggregate of more than twenty days during any one year

school_setting_exemption.quote: Person employed by a school board performing the duties of a position for the school. The person may not represent himself or herself as a behavior analyst, unless the person holds a license under this chapter

organizational_behavior_management_exemp.quote: Professional who provides general applied behavior analysis services to an organization, so long as the services are for the benefit of the organization and do not involve direct services to any person

nonhuman_animal_behaviorist_exemption.quote: Behavior analyst who practices with nonhumans, including an applied animal behaviorist and animal trainer

researcher_educator_exemption.quote: Employee of a regionally accredited academic institution while performing teaching, training, or research duties

value: long-term counseling as a treatment modality
